atr_locations_2022_onward.meaning: All-borough location/year aggregates; records are source rows, not vehicles.
atr_locations_2022_onward.timestamp_note: File modification time is a download-time proxy, not observation time.

atr_locations_all_years.meaning: Location/year aggregates for Manhattan, Brooklyn and Queens only.

speed_snapshot.meaning: Unordered 2,000-row sample; incomplete and unsuitable for proving absent coverage.

speed_links.meaning: Attempted distinct link inventory; an absent file indicates failed retrieval.

mim_speed_snapshot.meaning: One live local-street snapshot, not a historical archive; speed unit is ft/s.
